_comment: wave 22 (sequence accessors, tgeompoint windowed aggregations). The window's point stream is built as a CONTINUOUS sequence ([...], linear) so the MEOS sequence accessors apply (they reject the discrete {...} instant set the other tgeo aggregates build). TemporalNumSequences is a REGEN of the existing op fixed to build continuous (fold=tgeoseq, scalar int); start/end/sequence_n return a TSequence* serialized via tspatial_out (fold=tgeoseqtext).

operators.comment_one_liner: temporal_num_sequences (int) - the number of sequences in the windowed continuous trajectory.
temporal_start_sequence (Temporal *) - the first sequence of the windowed continuous trajectory.
temporal_end_sequence (Temporal *) - the last sequence of the windowed continuous trajectory.
temporal_sequence_n (Temporal *) - the first sequence (n=1) of the windowed continuous trajectory.
